concept.title: Foot care for someone who cannot manage their own
concept.shortdesc: As an older or disabled person who cannot cut my own toenails, I need foot care, so that I can walk without pain.

conbody.note: Draft need (N-035). The needs catalogue is a model's draft from persona use cases and has not been agreed with stakeholders; the category links are proposals and are not confirmed.

section.title: The need
section.p: Who: older people, people with limited mobility.
Situation: A practical health need that is easy to overlook.
A good result: Foot health services with whether they are free, how to refer and whether they visit at home.
How much it matters: Important: a miss leaves someone without help they need.

section.title: How the draft did on this need
section.p: Model-judged, in four places, with no human check yet. See for how to read it.
